cohort: N/A - This is a literature review synthesizing evidence on pregnancies affected by early and late-intrauterine growth retardation.
finding: Early and late-IUGR follow different patterns of progression, are associated with distinct complications (e.g., preeclampsia with early-IUGR), and require specific monitoring strategies (ultrasound, Doppler, cardiotocography, cerebroplacental ratio) to guide the timing of delivery.
